name: Hideous Humor
body:
Prerequisites: Ability to cast hideous laughter as a spell or spell-like ability.

Benefit: When you cast hideous laughter at a creature not of your type, it does not receive a +4 bonus to its saving throw against the spell. If you cast hideous laughter at a creature already under the effects of the spell and it fails its save, the duration of the second casting is added to the ongoing spell duration, and the target does not receive a saving throw on its second round to negate the second spell casting.

Additionally, even without the hideous laughter spell, you may make Perform (comedy) checks to demoralize foes able to hear and understand you (as the demoralize function of Intimidate).
